message: <input type="text" name="q"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
"yes" isn’t a value for disabled: the attribute is on whenever it’s present. Write disabled="true", or remove it to turn it off.
